Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang after he had two extramarital affairs, including one with a suspected Chinese spy , the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday (Nov 11), citing people familiar with the matter.
The board is preparing to meet as soon as Wednesday to determine his future, the report added.
Earlier in the day, the New York Times reported that Huang had an extramarital affair with a company executive who reported to him.
Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The reports come days after Huang acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife , as Nvidia's board investigates whether he was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation.
Nvidia's shares were down about 8 per cent in after-hours trading.

items.title: ＯＰＥＣプラス、10月大幅増産　サウジがけん引　開戦前に迫る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Alex Lawler　Olesya Astakhova

[ロンドン １１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Alex Lawler　Olesya Astakhova

[ロンドン １１日 ロイター] - 石油輸出国機構（ＯＰＥＣ）とロシアなど非加盟産油国でつくる「ＯＰＥＣプラス」の１０月の原油生産量が前月比で大幅に増加した。ＯＰＥＣが１１日に公表した月報で明らかになった。イランでの戦争に起因するホルムズ海峡経由の輸送混乱が続く中でも、サウジアラビアの生産が大きく増えて全体を押し上げた。

ＯＰＥＣによると、ＯＰＥＣプラスの１０月の原油生産量は日量４１２３万バレルで、９月から約２０４万バレル増加した。

生産量の増加は、ペルシャ湾岸産油国が船舶間移送（ＳＴＳ）などの代替手段を活用し、紛争による物流障害を回避しながら輸出を回復させていることを改めて示している。

ＯＰＥＣ統計に基づくロイターの試算では、１０月の生産量は、ＯＰＥＣプラスが２月に記録した日量４２７２万バレルの９７％に相当する水準となった。

サウジがＯＰＥＣに報告した１０月の生産量は日量１０５６万３０００バレルで、９月の日量８３７万２０００バレルから大幅に増加し、２月の日量１０８８万２０００バレル以来の高水準となった。同国はこれまでも市場の供給混乱時には増産し、供給過剰の懸念がある場合には減産するなど、原油市場の安定化に向けて介入してきた。

ロシアの１０月の原油生産量は日量８６６万８０００バレルとなり、９月から４万１０００バレル増加した。

ＯＰＥＣは、６カ月連続で下方修正していた世界の石油需要予測を据え置き、２０２７年の見通しについても変更しなかった。今年は日量１８万バレル需要が増加し、２７年は日量２５５万バレル増の平均１億０８３０万バレルに達するとみている。

items.body:
＜為替＞ 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。 ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１５９．８４円。約２カ月ぶりの高値を付け、心理的な節目の１ドル＝１６０円に迫った。 ユーロは０．６５％安の１．１１ドル。前営業日から下げが続き、２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。 ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。 ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。 英ポンドは０．５０％安の１．３３ドルと、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。ドルは対スイスフランで１０月中旬以来の高値を付けた後、０．９３％高の０．８３３スイスフランとなった。 ドル指数は０．６８％高の１０２．９０となった。一時、２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。 暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．９３％高の７万４４６０．４１ドル。イーサリアムは１．１９％高の２０７９．３１ドルとなった。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 休場

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ 米国株式市場は反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手掛けるコアウィーブの決算を受け、ＡＩ関連株相場の持続性を巡る投資家の懸念が和らぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合はともに１％超上昇した。エヌビディアも２営業日連続の急落から持ち直した。 これまで売り込まれていたコアウィーブは２４．７％急伸。１日の上昇率としては約３カ月ぶりの大きさとなり、２週間ぶりの高値で引けた。 同社は２０２８年上期に調整後ベースで黒字化するとの見通しを示した。nL6N46R1FZ ＡＩインフラ関連株全般で投資家心理が改善し、ネビウス・グループは１５．４％、アプライド・デジタルは７．４％それぞれ急伸した。 エヌビディアも上昇した。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と、中国のスパイとの疑いが持たれている女性との関係が投資家の懸念を招き、直前の２営業日で時価総額が約４３００億ドル消失していた。 株式相場はここ数日、不安定な値動きが続いている。先週の中間選挙で民主党が大勝したことを受け、投資家の間ではＡＩ分野の規制強化への懸念が浮上。エヌビディアのＣＥＯを巡る不安と相まって、現在の強気相場を支える主要な柱の一つであるＡＩ株に圧力がかかった。 投資家が原油価格の下落を好感する一方、米国債利回りの急上昇を招いたインフレ圧力の強さを示す指標を懸念していることも、株価の不安定な動きにつながっている。 グローバルトのシニアポートフォリオマネジャー、トーマス・マーティン氏は「誰もが毎日、『炭鉱のカナリア』（危険の予兆）を探し、それに日々反応している」と指摘。「ＡＩは良い、いやそれほど良くないという見方の間を、何度も行き来している。心配だと言ったかと思えば、今度は素晴らしいとなる」と語った。 フィラデルフィア半導体指数は５．７％急伸し、終値として１１月３日以来の高値を付けた。全構成銘柄が上昇した。 最近の強い売り圧力を受け、一部の投資家は押し目買いに動いた。ただ、初期の指標を見る限り、警戒を解くのは時期尚早だ。 バンク・オブ・アメリカ・グローバル・リサーチのアナリストはリポートで、先週の急落局面でも投資家は株式を購入していたと指摘。純流入は全て上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）を通じたもので、機関投資家が買いを主導したという。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 米国のインフレ指標が市場予想を上回り、ＦＲＢ高官によるタカ派的な発言も重なったことで、ドル高が進み、金相場は続落した。

１２月限の清算値は前日比０．７％安の１オンス＝４０００．５０ドル。金現物は一時４０６６．７７ドルまで戻したが、午後には１．１％安の３９８６．７９ドルとなり、前日の約３％安に続く下落となった。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 米国時間の原油先物は、約１％上昇した。イランの安全保障担当トップが濃縮核物質の国外搬出を認めないと述べたことを受け、供給懸念が再燃した。前営業日に付けた約２カ月ぶりの安値から持ち直した。 北海ブレント先物の清算値は、前日比１．２７ドル（１．３９％）高の１バレル＝９２．７６ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．４９ドル（０．５７％）高の８６．５３ドルだった。 イラン最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長は、濃縮核物質は一粒たりとも国外に持ち出すことを認めないと強調した。また、米国がイランを再び攻撃すれば相応の結果を招くと警告した。 米政府は、イランとの戦争終結を目指す初期の交渉では、核問題を議題に含めなければならないとの立場を示している。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

items.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝ドル上昇、米利上げ観測で　円は160円に迫る
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。

ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１５９．８４円。約２カ月ぶりの高値を付け、心理的な節目の１ドル＝１６０円に迫った。

ユーロは０．６５％安の１．１１ドル。前営業日から下げが続き、２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。

ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。

ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。

英ポンドは０．５０％安の１．３３ドルと、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。ドルは対スイスフランで１０月中旬以来の高値を付けた後、０．９３％高の０．８３３スイスフランとなった。

ドル指数は０．６８％高の１０２．９０となった。一時、２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．９３％高の７万４４６０．４１ドル。イーサリアムは１．１９％高の２０７９．３１ドルとなった。

items.title: Fitch advierte que podría rebajar la calificación crediticia de Paraguay tras la quiebra de Ueno Bank
items.author: Carolina Wilson
items.summary: Según un comunicado, la agencia calificadora asignó una calificación negativa a la deuda a largo plazo en moneda extranjera de Paraguay, que actualmente ostenta una perspectiva positiva (BB+).
items.body: Bloomberg — Fitch Ratings puso la calificación crediticia de Paraguay en revisión para una posible rebaja este miércoles, al señalar los riesgos que la crisis bancaria —que provocó la caída del presidente Santiago Peña y sacudió a los inversionistas— representa para las finanzas y la economía del país. Según un comunicado, la agencia calificadora asignó una calificación negativa a la deuda a largo plazo en moneda extranjera de Paraguay, que actualmente ostenta una perspectiva positiva (BB+). Esta decisión se produce tras el colapso del Ueno Bank, el sexto banco más grande del país sudamericano, que fue intervenido por los reguladores a principios de este mes después de que su capital cayera por debajo de los niveles requeridos. Ver más: La caída de Ueno Bank en Paraguay: diferencias clave frente al “corralito” argentino de 2001 Según Fitch, este cambio “refleja las posibles repercusiones de la quiebra del Ueno Bank y las consecuencias políticas derivadas de ella”. “Estas repercusiones incluyen efectos en el sistema bancario en general y en las finanzas públicas, dados los depósitos públicos y privados invertidos en el banco, así como en el crecimiento y la continuidad de las políticas”. La quiebra del banco provocó protestas generalizadas después de que los depositantes quedaran inicialmente sin acceso a sus cuentas, lo que desencadenó una crisis política que culminó con el juicio político y la destitución de Peña. Posteriormente, las autoridades afirmaron que la mayoría de los titulares de cuentas ya han recibido sus fondos . “La gestión que haga el gobierno de la quiebra bancaria, incluyendo la devolución oportuna de los fondos de los depositantes y la rendición de cuentas de los implicados, pondrá a prueba a sus instituciones”, dijo Fitch. La agencia calificadora advirtió que el gobierno podría verse presionado para compensar a los depositantes no asegurados, incluidas las entidades del sector público, con aproximadamente US$900 millones en riesgo, equivalentes al 1,5% del producto interno bruto. Los costos potenciales ejercen una presión adicional sobre Paraguay en medio de crecientes déficits presupuestarios y mayores necesidades de financiamiento. Fitch también señaló que la crisis de Ueno podría afectar “el momento, el tamaño, los costos y la moneda” del esperado regreso del gobierno a los mercados de bonos globales a principios de 2027. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: サウジ、フーシ派のミサイルなど迎撃　連合軍「リヤドやメッカ標的」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ドバイ １１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ドバイ １１日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアの防空部隊は１１日、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派が首都リヤドやイスラム教の聖地メッカなどに向けて発射したミサイルと無人機（ドローン）を迎撃した。

フーシ派と戦うサウジ主導の軍事連合によると、リヤド地域に向けられた巡航ミサイル３発、メッカと南部地域を狙ったドローン２機、西部に向けられたミサイル２発を迎撃・破壊した。

世界中のイスラム教徒にとって聖地であるメッカは、イスラム教で最も神聖な都市であり、イスラム教の五行の一つである毎年の大巡礼（ハッジ）の中心地だ。

フーシ派の軍報道官ヤヒヤ・サレア氏はその後、ドローンでメッカを標的にしたことを否定し、同組織の作戦は石油施設と軍事基地を標的にしていると述べた。

サレア氏はまた、ホルムズ海峡が封鎖される中で輸出を可能にしているサウジの主要な石油拠点ヤンブーのポンプ施設を攻撃したと述べた。このフーシ派の声明についてサウジ側の確認は得られていない。

items.title: ゼレンスキー氏、年内の成果に期待　「米ロ協議の行方が鍵」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Padraic Halpin

[ダブリン １１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Padraic Halpin

[ダブリン １１日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１１日、ロシアとの戦争終結を巡る協議で年内に具体的な成果を得たいと表明した。ただ、米国がロシアにどのような姿勢で臨むかに多くがかかっていると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、ウクライナとロシアの交渉担当者がアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）の首都アブダビで米国主導の協議を２日間行った後、アイルランドのマーティン首相と共同記者会見を行った。

ゼレンスキー氏は記者会見で「多くは、明日の米ロ双方の対話の形式にかかっている。今われわれが目にしている状況を踏まえれば、米国にとっても年内に成果を上げることが非常に重要だと思う。そして、米国は本当にそれを強く望んでいるように見える」と述べた。

アブダビで行われたロシアとウクライナ、米国の協議は、２日間の日程を終え、捕虜交換などで一定の進展があった。ただ、戦争終結に向けた具体的な動きに関する発表はほとんどなかった。

トランプ米大統領の娘婿で米特使を務めるジャレッド・クシュナー氏とトランプ米政権のウィットコフ中東担当特使は１２日にモスクワを訪れてプーチン氏と会談し、協議を欧州のパートナーにも広げる問題を提起する。

items.title: 米国株式市場＝反発、コアウィーブ決算受けＡＩ投資巡る懸念後退
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Chuck Mikolajczak　Utkarsh Hathi

［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手掛けるコアウィーブの決算を受け、ＡＩ関連株相場の持続性を巡る投資家の懸念が和らぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合はともに１％超上昇した。エヌビディアも２営業日連続の急落から持ち直した。

これまで売り込まれていたコアウィーブは２４．７％急伸。１日の上昇率としては約３カ月ぶりの大きさとなり、２週間ぶりの高値で引けた。
items.body:
Chuck Mikolajczak　Utkarsh Hathi

［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手掛けるコアウィーブの決算を受け、ＡＩ関連株相場の持続性を巡る投資家の懸念が和らぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合はともに１％超上昇した。エヌビディアも２営業日連続の急落から持ち直した。

これまで売り込まれていたコアウィーブは２４．７％急伸。１日の上昇率としては約３カ月ぶりの大きさとなり、２週間ぶりの高値で引けた。 同社は２０２８年上期に調整後ベースで黒字化するとの見通しを示した。

ＡＩインフラ関連株全般で投資家心理が改善し、ネビウス・グループは１５．４％、アプライド・デジタルは７．４％それぞれ急伸した。

エヌビディアも上昇した。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と、中国のスパイとの疑いが持たれている女性との関係が投資家の懸念を招き、直前の２営業日で時価総額が約４３００億ドル消失していた。

株式相場はここ数日、不安定な値動きが続いている。先週の中間選挙で民主党が大勝したことを受け、投資家の間ではＡＩ分野の規制強化への懸念が浮上。エヌビディアのＣＥＯを巡る不安と相まって、現在の強気相場を支える主要な柱の一つであるＡＩ株に圧力がかかった。

投資家が原油価格の下落を好感する一方、米国債利回りの急上昇を招いたインフレ圧力の強さを示す指標を懸念していることも、株価の不安定な動きにつながっている。

グローバルトのシニアポートフォリオマネジャー、トーマス・マーティン氏は「誰もが毎日、『炭鉱のカナリア』（危険の予兆）を探し、それに日々反応している」と指摘。「ＡＩは良い、いやそれほど良くないという見方の間を、何度も行き来している。心配だと言ったかと思えば、今度は素晴らしいとなる」と語った。

フィラデルフィア半導体指数は５．７％急伸し、終値として１１月３日以来の高値を付けた。全構成銘柄が上昇した。

最近の強い売り圧力を受け、一部の投資家は押し目買いに動いた。ただ、初期の指標を見る限り、警戒を解くのは時期尚早だ。

バンク・オブ・アメリカ・グローバル・リサーチのアナリストはリポートで、先週の急落局面でも投資家は株式を購入していたと指摘。純流入は全て上場投資信託（ＥＴＦ）を通じたもので、機関投資家が買いを主導したという。

Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の情報技術株指数は２．７％上昇し、主要１１セクターで最大の上昇率となった。４営業日のうち３営業日で上昇している。

「恐怖指数」と呼ばれるＶＩＸ指数は４営業日続落し、１週間ぶりの低水準となる１７．４９で引けた。先週は約７カ月ぶりの高水準を付けていた。

投資家は、ＡＩ開発のアンソロピックが１０日に示した新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）の条件にも注目した。調達額は最大６４４億ドル、評価額は最大１兆４０００億ドルとなる見通しだ。バンダ・リサーチはリポートで、このＩＰＯに伴う個人投資家の１日の買い付け額がスペースＸを上回り、過去最大級となる可能性があると指摘した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．４８対１の比率で上回った。ナスダック市場では１．７７対１で値上がり銘柄数が多かった。

米取引所の出来高は１４７億４０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均１８６億８０００万株を下回った。

items.author: ロイター

Chuck Mikolajczak　Utkarsh Hathi

［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 米国株式...
items.body:
米国株式市場＝反発、コアウィーブ決算受けＡＩ投資巡る懸念後退
7:11 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所で11月10日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid（ロイター） Chuck Mikolajczak　Utkarsh Hathi

［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場は反発して取引を終えた。人工知能（ＡＩ）向けクラウドサービスを手掛けるコアウィーブの決算を受け、ＡＩ関連株相場の持続性を巡る投資家の懸念が和らぎ、Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合はともに１％超上昇した。エヌビディアも２営業日連続の急落から持ち直した。

これまで売り込まれていたコアウィーブは２４．７％急伸。１日の上昇率としては約３カ月ぶりの大きさとなり、２週間ぶりの高値で引けた。 同社は２０２８年上期に調整後ベースで黒字化するとの見通しを示した。

ＡＩインフラ関連株全般で投資家心理が改善し、ネビウス・グループは１５．４％、アプライド・デジタルは７．４％それぞれ急伸した。

エヌビディアも上昇した。ジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）と、中国のスパイとの疑いが持たれている女性との関係が投資家の懸念を招き、直前の２営業日で時価総額が約４３００億ドル消失していた。

株式相場はここ数日、不安定な値動きが続いている。先週の中間選挙で民主党が大勝したことを受け、投資家の間ではＡＩ分野の規制強化への懸念が浮上。エヌビディアのＣＥＯを巡る不安と相まって、現在の強気相場を支える主要な柱の一つであるＡＩ株に圧力がかかった。

投資家が原油価格の下落を好感する一方、米国債利回りの急上昇を招いたインフレ圧力の強さを示す指標を懸念していることも、株価の不安定な動きにつながっている。

グローバルトのシニアポートフォリオマネジャー、トーマス・マーティン氏は「誰もが毎日、『炭鉱のカナリア』（危険の予兆）を探し、それに日々反応している」と指摘。「ＡＩは良い、いやそれほど良くないという見方の間を、何度も行き来している。心配だと言ったかと思えば、今度は素晴らしいとなる」と語った。

items.title: Tesoro argentino informa rollover superior al 100% pero liberará pesos tras tensión en las tasas
items.author: Tomás Carrió
items.summary: La Secretaría de Finanzas adjudicó ARS$8,87 billones. El monto representa un 103% sobre los vencimientos, pero analistas apuntan a un rollover efectivo de 84%, por lo que liberará unos ARS$1,7 billone ...
items.body: Buenos Aires — El Tesoro argentino liberará ARS$1,7 billones tras la tensión que se vivió la semana pasada en el mercado local ante una escases de pesos que disparó las tasas de corto plazo. Pese a que informó un rollover superior al 100% sobre los vencimientos, la Secretaría de Finanzas optó por liberar pesos por primera vez en una licitación de deuda desde agosto dado que los ARS$8,87 billones adjudicados quedaron por debajo de los ARS$10,6 billones que vencían si se contemplan los pagos de dos instrumentos de deuda en pesos efectuados este miércoles. Si bien la Secretaría de Finanzas informó un rollover de 103,07% tras recibir ofertas por ARS$11,6 billones, analistas coincidieron en marcar que el resultado de la licitación será expansivo por los pagos del TX26 y TX28, efectuados este miércoles. Así, indicaron que el rollover efectivo se redujo a 84%. “Esto implica que expandieron unos $1,7 billones aproximadamente”, calculó el equipo de research de Puente. La decisión de liberar pesos llega después de que la semana pasada, en la antesala de los feriados por la visita del Papa León XIV, el mercado argentino evidenciara señales de tensión por la ajustada liquidez del sistema, lo que se tradujo en un fuerte incremento de las tasas de caución y en la rueda REPO. En la licitación, agregaron los analistas de Puente, el Tesoro “debió pagar 100 puntos básicos sobre los dos instrumentos a tasa fija”, aunque añadieron que “el resto de los instrumentos quedaron medianamente igual que el mercado secundario”. Por otra parte, destacaron que la mayor parte de las posturas demandaron el nuevo BONTAM a abril 2027, que cerró a sólo TAMAR +2,5%, aunque también señalaron que “casi no hubo demanda por el BONCER TZX28, el único instrumento que se ofrecía más allá de las elecciones del año que viene”. Desde Aldazabal & Cía también subrayaron que la nueva letra TAMAR TMA27, con vencimiento en abril 2027, explicó 40% del monto colocado, en tanto que los dos instrumentos a tasa fija (S29E7 y T30J7) aportaron en conjunto otro 40%. Así, indicaron que “el plazo promedio de colocación fue de 163 días, sensiblemente por debajo del nivel de la licitación previa (355 días)”, en la medida que se colocaron solo ARS$0,4 billones de TZX28, el único título ofrecido con vencimiento post-elecciones.

items.title: Venezuela enviará equipos petroleros a EE.UU. para su reparación por primera vez en más de una década
items.author: Fabiola Zerpa
items.summary: El presidente de Petróleos de Venezuela SA, Héctor Obregón, firmó el 23 de octubre los documentos que autorizan el envío de cuatro generadores y seis compresores de gas a los talleres de Siemens Energ ...
items.body: Bloomberg — Venezuela enviará equipos petroleros de propiedad estatal a Estados Unidos para su reparación por primera vez en más de una década, retomando la colaboración con proveedores tradicionales tras años de sanciones y falta de inversión. El presidente de Petróleos de Venezuela SA, Héctor Obregón, firmó el 23 de octubre los documentos que autorizan el envío de cuatro generadores y seis compresores de gas a los talleres de Siemens Energy Inc. en Houston, según documentos a los que tuvo acceso Bloomberg . Los equipos partieron hacia Houston el miércoles por la mañana y, una vez restaurados, se instalarán en el lago Maracaibo para ayudar a aumentar la producción, según una persona familiarizada con la operación que no estaba autorizada a hablar públicamente. Ver más: Nueve de cada diez viviendas se venden por debajo del precio publicado en Venezuela La empresa norteamericana Blue Energy Partners —dirigida por Alejandro Betancourt, el mediador de confianza de la Administración Trump para Venezuela— gestionó el acuerdo, según la misma fuente. Las reparaciones, cuyo costo para Nabep se estima en unos US$46 millones, tardarán entre tres y seis meses en completarse, añadió la fuente. “Estamos revitalizando la infraestructura petrolera de Venezuela en múltiples frentes, con maquinaria pesada que se está restaurando en tres continentes”, afirmó Nabep en un comunicado. “Al transformar los activos, antes obsoletos y que ahora están inmediatamente a nuestra disposición, en equipos de primera categoría, podemos ampliar nuestra producción mucho más rápidamente”. Los representantes de PDVSA no respondieron de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. Siemens Energy se negó a hacer declaraciones. Este equipamiento es clave para aumentar la producción de petróleo en el oeste de Venezuela, el corazón de la industria petrolera del país, donde los pozos se han deteriorado. Las reparaciones son esenciales para que Nabep alcance su objetivo de producir 500.000 barriles al día para finales de 2028, en el marco de su acuerdo con el Departamento de Defensa de EE.UU. para al menos 17 yacimientos de la zona. Tras las reparaciones, el equipo enviado a Houston contribuirá a aumentar la producción en al menos 60.000 barriles al día, según indicó dicha persona. Además, Nabep tiene previsto conectar dos turbinas en sus zonas de trabajo del estado de Zulia para abastecer de energía a sus actividades. La nueva ley de hidrocarburos exige a las empresas de perforación que se autoabastezcan de energía. Ver más: Venezuela prepara un nuevo esquema de tarifas eléctricas: qué podría cambiar para los usuarios Tras romper relaciones con EE.UU. a principios de la década de 2000, el Gobierno de Caracas había firmado acuerdos de mantenimiento con Irán y China. El equipo reacondicionado permitirá reinyectar gas en los pozos para que el petróleo fluya con mayor facilidad. El gas también contribuirá a abastecer las centrales eléctricas utilizadas para las operaciones. --Con la colaboración de Marilen Martín. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

Australian companies face 'AI washing' claims after wave of job cuts, offshoring

FAST

SYDNEY, Nov 12 : Australia's blue-chip companies are increasingly invoking artificial intelligence as they cut jobs and move work offshore, unions and experts say, complicating the government's efforts to support employment in a slowing economy.
On Tuesday, Qantas, Australia's flag carrier, said it would cut 850 jobs and outsource some corporate functions offshore as part of an AI-driven overhaul with consulting firm Accenture, a move that has raised accusations of "AI washing."
"AI washing" describes a practice by companies of attributing layoffs to AI tools when the primary driver may be broader cost-cutting measures, such as shifting jobs offshore.
Tech companies WiseTech and Atlassian have cut jobs this year, attributing the losses to AI. Telecommunications firm Telstra has also cut jobs from an AI joint venture with Accenture, with some work offshored to India.

More broadly, other firms across corporate Australia have also slashed their domestic headcounts while expanding operations in India, the Philippines and Vietnam, though they did not explicitly mention AI in their announcements.
When asked about the Qantas job cuts, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, who was unveiling the response to a recent breach of a government website by an OpenAI agent, said AI "represents an enormous opportunity and a major economic issue."
Labour unions have argued that Australian workers were not being replaced by AI, but by lower-paid offshore employees.
"Unions are concerned about the risk of companies using AI simply as a cover to cut Australian jobs with no accountability," said Australian Council of Trade Unions Secretary Melissa Donnelly.
"From Qantas to the big banks, workers deserve transparency and genuine consultation over decisions that impact their jobs and lives."
The Australian Services Union, which represents the affected Qantas workers, accused the airline of "using AI to launder their cuts to Australian jobs."
"We expect to see more of this cost cutting and race to the bottom if corporate Australia continues to copy this failed tactic," said Assistant National Secretary Scott Cowen.
Senator Barbara Pocock, a member of the Australian Greens party, said on Wednesday that she was concerned to see big companies engaging in "AI washing," using the technology as an excuse to cut jobs.
"AI is transforming our workplaces and economy but that's no excuse to let it run rampant," Pocock said in a statement.
A Qantas spokesperson said in a statement it would continue to consult with unions and that it was focused on "redeployment opportunities" and support for impacted staff. Qantas did not respond to the concerns around 'AI washing'.
Atlassian, WiseTech and Telstra did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
TREND TO CONTINUE
Further job cuts by companies could pose headaches for Australia's centre-left Labor government, with recent polls showing its approval ratings steadily falling amid high cost-of-living pressures.
The central bank has raised interest rates five times so far this year to their highest level in 18 years amid persistent inflation, while the latest data showed the unemployment rate at a five-year high of 4.7 per cent.
Uri Gal, a professor at the University of Sydney Business School, said a growing number of companies were blaming job cuts on AI, but "we should therefore be cautious about accepting AI as the primary explanation."
"There are real incentives to engage in AI washing," he said. "A company that announces job cuts to reduce costs may face criticism, whereas one that presents the same decision as part of an AI transformation can appear innovative and forward-looking."
Gal said the Qantas decision appeared to be due to conventional outsourcing and demonstrated how AI can help justify restructuring before the technology's productivity gains have materialised.
"The company has announced that some corporate functions will be transferred to Accenture, primarily in India, and explicitly states that these functions will subsequently be transformed through AI and automation," Gal said. "This raises an obvious question: if AI is making these jobs redundant, why does the work first need to be transferred to another group of employees?"
The Reserve Bank of Australia said this week AI had not yet led to widespread job losses, though it noted "tentative signs of adjustment," with job ads weakening in AI-exposed occupations and employment growing more strongly in less affected roles.
A government spokesperson said in a statement it expected Australian workers to see the benefits of new technologies and that employers should invest in upskilling them to adopt AI.

Source: Reuters

Uri Gal, a professor at the University of Sydney Business School, said a growing number of companies were blaming job cuts on AI, but "we should therefore be cautious about accepting AI as the primary explanation."
"There are real incentives to engage in AI washing," he said. "A company that announces job cuts to reduce costs may face criticism, whereas one that presents the same decision as part of an AI transformation can appear innovative and forward-looking."
Gal said the Qantas decision appeared to be due to conventional outsourcing and demonstrated how AI can help justify restructuring before the technology's productivity gains have materialised.
"The company has announced that some corporate functions will be transferred to Accenture, primarily in India, and explicitly states that these functions will subsequently be transformed through AI and automation," Gal said. "This raises an obvious question: if AI is making these jobs redundant, why does the work first need to be transferred to another group of employees?"
The Reserve Bank of Australia said this week AI had not yet led to widespread job losses, though it noted "tentative signs of adjustment," with job ads weakening in AI-exposed occupations and employment growing more strongly in less affected roles.
A government spokesperson said in a statement it expected Australian workers to see the benefits of new technologies and that employers should invest in upskilling them to adopt AI.

PARIS, Nov 11 : France's Alexia Barrier became the first woman to complete the Route du Rhum in the Ultim class on Wednesday, finishing fifth after a punishing transatlantic race that forced three of the eight giant trimarans to retire.
The 46-year-old crossed the finish line in Pointe-a-Pitre at 1542 local time on Wednesday (1942 GMT) aboard IDEC Sport-CIC, completing the 3,542-nautical-mile race from Saint-Malo to Guadeloupe in 10 days, 7 hours and 40 minutes.
She arrived more than three days behind her compatriot Tom Laperche, who skippered SVR-Lazartigue to victory in the Ultim class in record time.
Thomas Coville, aboard Sodebo Ultim 3, was second and Louis Burton, skipper of Armand Thiery, took third, with LIAMM skipper Guirec Soudee finishing just off the podium.

Barrier struggled to match the leaders aboard IDEC Sport-CIC, the oldest Ultim in the fleet, launched in 2006. Ultim trimarans can measure up to 32 metres long and 23 metres wide (105 feet by 75 feet).
But the strength and reliability of her boat enabled Barrier to finish the quadrennial race when three of her rivals failed to make it across the Atlantic.
Armel Le Cleac'h, skipper of Maxi Banque Populaire XI, capsized off the Azores last Wednesday, three days after the start. The 2016-17 Vendee Globe winner was later rescued by a Panamanian cargo ship.
Defending champion Charles Caudrelier retired from the race after suffering foil damage to his new Maxi Edmond de Rothschild-Gitana 18, while Actual Ultim 4 skipper Anthony Marchand withdrew because of a major problem with his central rudder.
Barrier also endured problems of her own, attempting to repair a torn mainsail before encountering a winch issue in the closing days of the race.
One of only 13 women to complete the Vendee Globe, Barrier also led the first all-female crew to complete the Jules Verne Trophy course 10 months ago and has again broken new ground in a discipline long dominated by men.
Her next target is the Arkea Ultim Challenge, a solo race around the world for giant Ultim class trimarans, whose second edition is due to start in January 2028.

Source: Reuters

items.title: 原油先物1％高、イランが核物質の国外搬出認めず　供給懸念再燃
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Nicole Jao

[ニューヨーク １１日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Nicole Jao

[ニューヨーク １１日 ロイター] - 米国時間の原油先物は、約１％上昇した。イランの安全保障担当トップが濃縮核物質の国外搬出を認めないと述べたことを受け、供給懸念が再燃した。前営業日に付けた約２カ月ぶりの安値から持ち直した。

北海ブレント先物の清算値は、前日比１．２７ドル（１．３９％）高の１バレル＝９２．７６ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は０．４９ドル（０．５７％）高の８６．５３ドルだった。

イラン最高安全保障委員会（ＳＮＳＣ）のレザイ事務局長は、濃縮核物質は一粒たりとも国外に持ち出すことを認めないと強調した。また、米国がイランを再び攻撃すれば相応の結果を招くと警告した。

米政府は、イランとの戦争終結を目指す初期の交渉では、核問題を議題に含めなければならないとの立場を示している。

items.title: Market Outlook: Canadian stocks offer exposure to AI buildout
items.author: BNN Bloomberg
items.summary: Lorne Steinberg discusses CoreWeave’s results, software stock valuations and Canadian opportunities tied to AI and infrastructure spending.
items.body: CoreWeave’s stronger third-quarter results and increased annual guidance have brought renewed attention to the AI cloud sector following a technology sell-off. BNN Bloomberg spoke with Lorne Steinberg, co-president of Lorne Steinberg Wealth Management, about the implications for technology shares and opportunities tied to Canada’s major project buildout. Key Takeaways Read the full transcript below: ROGER: CoreWeave showed a strong third quarter, lifting its guidance for the year. The neocloud provider has been facing pressure in recent months as investors continue to weigh a volatile tech trade. Let’s get more from Lorne Steinberg, co-president of Lorne Steinberg Wealth Management. Lorne, thanks as always for joining us. LORNE: Thank you, Roger. ROGER: OK, it’s been a rough little while, but a good day today for CoreWeave. What do you see they did right, and what’s driving this? LORNE: Well, I think the No. 1 thing is the stock’s been under tremendous pressure, in large part due to the amount of money they’ve had to borrow, and the bond prices for CoreWeave have been decimated, which would have made it very difficult to raise more cash. So today’s print, I think, gives investors, first of all, a lot of comfort that CoreWeave’s revenues are on track. They’ve raised their guidance that they’re going to deliver over $13 billion of revenues this year. Their margins have improved, but I think, really significantly, they’ve indicated, Roger, that they’re only going to have to raise about $5 billion through 2027 to meet their buildout capacity that they have promised to their customers, and they should be easily able to do that at bond prices that would probably be in the seven to eight per cent range. So it’s a huge sigh of relief to investors and takes the pressure off in the near term. ROGER: So, so what does this mean then for other, other neoclouds like Nebulas — Nebius, excuse me — and IREN? LORNE: So, I think a lot of it has to do with the guidance provided that they are massively oversubscribed on the amount of capacity they can build out, so that, to me, makes the whole sector look very stable and strong growth for the next couple of years. I think the biggest issue going forward past, you know, ’27 or ’28 is the — of course, the midterm elections in the States, you know, indicate that we may get fewer data centres built out than are — were originally, you know, on the slate, and that could have a negative impact. The biggest tough thing for CoreWeave, but they’ve shown zero problem with this, is they have to deliver these data centres on time, or else they would be subject to penalties and possibly cancellation. But thus far, there have been — there’s been zero indication of that. So I think the industry is stable for next couple of years. But really, public policy may have some impact on the industry as a whole. But pretty positive for everybody. ROGER: So it’s going to — it sounds like it’s going to take some work. There must — there’s opportunities, though, in these moments, isn’t there? LORNE: Absolutely. The stock is still way down from where it was, but this gives investors a lot of comfort that the company is here to stay for the next few years. That’s for sure. ROGER: All right. Some names that pop up for you within tech: Constellation, Open Text, Adobe, Alphabet. What are you seeing there? What do you see for opportunities there? LORNE: So first of all, let me deal with a couple of Canadian stocks first. So Constellation Software has been a spectacular growth story, growth by acquisition, delivering, you know, 15 per cent annualized revenue growth, which we see continuing going forward. The stock was under pressure and way down from where it was. Of course, because people feared AI would cut into the need for software. But they really deal with small and medium-sized businesses to a great extent. Those companies just don’t have the capacity to do it themselves. So for us, this is — remains a great opportunity to get into one of Canada’s few real growth stories, and a company with a — you know, in a pretty unique position. The second company is Open Text. Open Text has been a zero grower for the past few years. They switched CEOs. We like what’s going on there, but Open Text, Roger, is actually the cheapest company in our portfolio, trading at about six times earnings, delivering significant free cash flow, and the new management team has been very clear that they are there to create value finally for shareholders, and that’s starting to take the form of share — significant share buybacks, as well as investing in growth, but also divesting themselves of assets which were basically going nowhere. On the U.S. side, let me be clear: one of the cheapest stocks we own is Adobe. Adobe, also another software company under pressure because of fears of AI, but there has been absolutely zero indication that anything is being cut out of their business. Every quarter is another 10 per cent-plus revenue and earnings grower, and at 10 times free cash flow, this company is actually buying back significant stock, and, you know, we see the stock worth double the current share price. And, and finally, when we look at Alphabet, you know, just among the best in the world at what they do, the best in many areas. Alphabet’s been under pressure because, of course, the AI spend, the capex they’re putting out, is eating up all of their free cash flow and then some for the next couple of years. That being said, Alphabet has over five — a backlog of over $500 billion. So a lot of this capex will be producing short-term return on investment very quickly. The company’s trading at the cheapest valuation it has in many years, 15 times earnings, and revenues are growing at an astounding 25 per cent, which we expect to continue per year for the next couple of years. So this is just an incredible opportune entry opportunity to get into a company of this quality. ROGER: OK, the other big AI, at least in Canada, the other big story — AI is everywhere, of course — but the big Canadian major project buildout. You’re seeing opportunities there. Finning showing up for you. Toromont, WSP. Some quick reasons on those ones why they’ve got your attention. LORNE: Sure. So Toromont, Toromont and Finning are the largest Caterpillar dealers. Finning’s the largest. Toromont second. And of course, to build out all of these projects, you’re going to need a lot of equipment, and you have nowhere else to go in Canada but Finning and Toromont. So these companies already have a record backlog, and these projects haven’t even started yet. They’ll both benefit from data centre buildout, infrastructure, etc. Interestingly, Toromont also has a division that caters specifically to data centres because they sell power supplies and in — and enclosures for data centres. Canada should be somewhat of a beneficiary if there’s some pushback in the U.S. of — in communities that don’t want to build data centres, and we’re already seeing data centre approvals here in Canada, you know, from the likes of Meta, et cetera. So both these companies are primed to deliver double-digit earnings growth for years to come. They also both happen to be dividend aristocrats, with Finning having raised its dividend every year for 25 straight years, Toromont every year for 37 straight years. So these are just two incredibly fine companies. WSP Global, of course, is the large engineering company, and they are poised to get contracts across the board. Critical minerals as they build out the Ring of Fire, transportation, data centres. The stock has been under pressure with most engineering companies because of fears that AI would require, you know, smaller contracts from large companies. There again is zero evidence of this, and we’re looking at WSP Global to be also a double-digit grower. So here are three Canadian companies that will absolutely benefit from the buildout in Canada. ROGER: All right, we have to wrap it up there, Lorne. But thanks as always for joining us. LORNE: Roger, thank you so much for having me. ROGER: Lorne Steinberg, co-president of Lorne Steinberg Wealth Management. --- This BNN Bloomberg summary and transcript of the Nov. 11, 2026 interview with Lorne Steinberg are published with the assistance of AI. Original research, interview questions and added context was created by BNN Bloomberg journalists. An editor also reviewed this material before it was published to ensure its accuracy and adherence with BNN Bloomberg editorial policies and standards.

Nov 11 : Kylian Mbappe will not feature in France's Nations League match against Italy on Thursday as he is not fully fit, coach Zinedine Zidane told reporters on Wednesday.
Mbappe missed France's last three matches after injuring his left knee while scoring the winner in their Nations League clash with Turkey on September 25.
L'Equipe reported that Mbappe was troubled by a hamstring problem and had missed Wednesday's training session with the national team.
"He will be out tomorrow. He felt a slight pain and, as usual, we won’t take any risks. Losing players is regrettable, but it’s part of the game. I hope it’s nothing serious and that we’ll have him back on Sunday," Zidane was quoted as saying by L'Equipe.

Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles, drones; group denies targeting Mecca

Reuters

12 November, 2026 01:30 am IST

DUBAI, Nov 11 (Reuters) – Saudi air defences intercepted Houthi missiles and drones launched towards Riyadh, Mecca and other regions on Wednesday, as hostilities between the Iran-aligned group and the kingdom worsen.

The Saudi-led military coalition fighting the Yemeni group said it had intercepted and destroyed three cruise missiles headed to the Riyadh region, two drones aimed at Mecca and southern areas and two missiles pointed towards the west.

Mecca, home to sites sacred to Muslims worldwide, is Islam’s holiest city and the focal point of the annual hajj pilgrimage, one of the five pillars of Islam, which millions of Muslims undertake each year.

Show Full Article

Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree later denied targeting Mecca with a drone, saying the group’s operations target oil facilities and military bases.

Saree also said the Houthis had attacked a pumping station in Saudi Arabia’s Yanbu, a key Saudi oil hub that allows exports to avoid the blocked Strait of Hormuz. There was no Saudi confirmation of the Houthi statement.

Saudi civil defence issued alerts warning of potential danger in the cities of Taif, Yanbu and Khamis Mushait later on Wednesday, then announced the danger had passed, state television reported.

The militia, which controls most of the populous parts of Yemen, has intensified attacks on the Saudi capital in recent days, saying it was responding to Saudi attacks in Yemen. A Houthi attack on Sunday damaged an Aramco administrative building in Riyadh’s financial hub.

Wednesday’s interceptions marked the second consecutive day that Saudi air defences had intercepted Houthi missiles launched towards Riyadh, after they downed a ballistic missile and a cruise missile on Tuesday, the coalition said.

Last month, a Houthi attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport killed 13 people and wounded more than 300.

Renewed fighting between the two sides has intensified since September, when the Houthis advanced towards the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, a strategic shipping chokepoint at the southern entrance to the Red Sea.

The Houthis have since stepped up strikes on Saudi airports, ports and oil facilities, while Saudi Arabia has ramped up airstrikes on Houthi targets in Yemen in response.

(Reporting by Nayera Abdallah, Jana Choukeir, Yomna Ehab and Ahmed TolbaEditing by Ros Russell, Peter Graff, Philippa Fletcher and Cynthia Osterman)

Democrats are ready to fight Trump on immigration. But how much can they achieve?

Reuters

12 November, 2026 01:30 am IST

Follow Us:

By Julia Harte, Kristina Cooke and Richard Cowan
Nov 11 (Reuters) – Democratic lawmakers are gearing up to fight President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown when in control of Congress next year, targeting ICE tactics and expanding paths to legal status despite limits on how much they can achieve.

Democrats handily won control of both chambers of Congress last week, fueled in part by voters’ dissatisfaction with Trump’s aggressive arrest and deportation campaign. But lawmakers from both parties expect Stephen Miller, the architect of that campaign and Trump’s new chief of staff, to go on driving immigration policy.

House and Senate staffers told Reuters they expect the president to veto any legislation that would curb immigration enforcement or expand pathways to legal residency and citizenship.

Show Full Article

Trump’s immigration crackdown has become a political vulnerability, with his approval on the issue falling to 38% from 50% at the start of his presidency, based on Reuters/Ipsos polling, and Latino voters swinging sharply back to Democrats in the midterms after tilting Republican in 2024.

In a Friday interview with CBS’ “60 Minutes,” Trump acknowledged his deportation strategy may have been “too tough.” Asked about that by reporters on Monday, Trump responded: “My policy has not changed.”

Democrats will have more latitude on oversight. They have already drawn up a list of investigative targets at the Department of Homeland Security, the parent agency of Immigration and Customs Enforcement, according to staffers, including detention center conditions, fatal use of force by federal agents and the 2025 deportation of Venezuelans to a Salvadoran megaprison.

“We will investigate the administration weaponizing DHS against Americans (and) its out of control immigration policies,” US Representative Bennie Thompson, a Mississippi Democrat and the soon-to-be chair of the House Homeland Security Committee, told Reuters in a statement.  

The party also plans to push for greater transparency into how DHS is spending the more than $100 billion allocated by Congress since last year, staffers said, speaking on condition of anonymity.

At a Wednesday press conference at the US Capitol with House members and newly elected representatives from southwestern border states, Henry Cuellar, a centrist Texas Democrat, said he had already had conversations with Trump officials about focusing deportation efforts on criminals.

“We’re not going to be extreme,” Cuellar said, nodding to conservative voters across the United States who cast their votes for Democrats.

Asked for a response to this story, White House spokesperson Taylor Rogers told Reuters in a statement: “The Democrats are colossally misreading the electorate if they think the American people want an extremist, anti-American immigration agenda.”

The Department of Homeland Security did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.

The Democratic Party is in a “whole new world when it comes to their immigration agenda,” said Sarah Pierce, social policy director at the center-left Third Way think tank.

“They’ve clearly broken from the policy that we saw under the Biden administration, but they have yet to offer a proactive vision for what immigration should look like.”

Democrat Joe Biden, president from 2021 to 2025, initially rolled back some of the restrictive immigration policies of Trump’s first four-year term before taking a tougher approach to the border late in his presidency.

REINING IN ICE

Some Democrats emerged from last week’s midterm elections ready for battle.

“We will rip ICE apart,” Senator-elect Peggy Flanagan said while celebrating her triumph in Minnesota, where federal immigration agents shot dead two US citizens during an enforcement surge in January.

US Representative Pramila Jayapal, a Washington state Democrat and the ranking member of the House Judiciary Committee’s immigration subcommittee, pledged to summon “every single one of these corrupt people that kidnapped and detained and deported and killed people in the streets.”

Just the specter of having to testify on Capitol Hill could change the behavior of federal officials, a Democratic congressional staffer said.

In a statement to Reuters, Josh Gottheimer, a moderate Democratic representative from New Jersey, highlighted the ICE Standards Act, which he introduced in March.

“Agents need real training and body cameras,” he said. “They need to wear clear identification unless they are on an undercover operation. They must coordinate with state and local law enforcement.” 

Republicans counter that they have already provided ICE with funding to purchase body cameras and have resisted Democratic attempts to place further guardrails on the agency.

On the campaign trail in 2024, Trump made no secret of his plans for an immigration crackdown. But the tactics of masked, armed federal agents, first in Minneapolis and then across the country, generated widespread outrage.

REFORMING THE SYSTEM

Jose Parra, a former US Senate aide with knowledge of current congressional discussions on immigration, said “voters moved the goal posts” last week, potentially opening the way for some stalled bills to advance.

He pointed to the Dignity Act, a bipartisan bill that would create a path to legal residence for workers while tightening border security and reforming visa programs.

Another bill likely to gain traction, Parra said, is the Dream and Promise Act, which would open a pathway to US citizenship for immigrants who arrived as children, known as “Dreamers.”

Despite Gallup polling that shows more than 80% of Americans support a legal pathway for Dreamers, even that legislation might be difficult to advance, according to a senior Senate Republican aide, who said any serious attempt would likely come closer to the next presidential election.

Parra agreed with that assessment, saying Republicans might want to “take that off the table and not let it be a messaging cudgel against them in 2028.”

Trump’s veto power will likely be an insurmountable barrier to enacting comprehensive immigration reform or clawing back the tens of billions of dollars already appropriated to ICE.  

“Congress has ceded so much of its authority and so much of its power to the executive,” said Claire Trickler-McNulty, a former senior ICE official. “There are real limitations on how much Congress can do.”

Still, she said, lawmakers could use funding deadlines and Senate confirmation votes as leverage. And they could pass measures redirecting ICE funding to popular programs like healthcare or school lunches, even if the bills die on Trump’s desk.  

At Wednesday’s press conference, US Senator Ruben Gallego, Democrat of Arizona, said his party will have to cut deals with Trump, and that members were already discussing how to move forward with a Dreamers bill by the end of 2026.

“Republicans have been saying we will have immigration reform as soon as we have a safe, secure border,” Gallego said. “We have that right now.”

(Reporting by Julia Harte in New York, Kristina Cooke in San Francisco and Richard Cowan in Washington. Editing by Jesse Mesner-Hage and Howard Goller)

Nov 11 : United Airlines said on Wednesday it would restrict AI bots' access to its digital platforms, citing data security, in the latest pushback against AI agents increasingly capable of planning and booking trips for travelers.
Here are some more details:
• Companies across industries are taking divergent approaches to the rapid rise of AI agents capable of carrying out tasks on behalf of users — some restricting access to protect their platforms, others embracing partnerships
• Amazon has blocked Meta's AI agent Muse, while Walmart has partnered with it

• Meanwhile, online travel firms such as Expedia and Booking are working with ChatGPT-parent OpenAI
• United warned that sharing account credentials with third-party AI assistants could expose sensitive information and lead to unintended purchases, account modifications or the unauthorized use of frequent-flyer miles
• It also said automated AI tools performing actions like flight check-in — which requires human acknowledgment for prohibited items such as explosives — could create regulatory risks
• The carrier said it would take steps to restrict access both directly through its digital platforms and indirectly through travel agencies and aggregators, including updates to its booking, ticketing and distribution policies

Nov 11 : The return of Jeremy Doku to the Belgium squad has handed coach Mark van Bommel a luxury problem, he said on Wednesday.
Doku, who was ill during the World Cup and had a subdued tournament, missed the opening four matches of the new Nations League campaign in September and October because of injury.
The winger is now fit, however, for their last two Group A1 fixtures against Turkey in Izmir on Thursday and Italy in Brussels on Sunday.
"I'm very pleased to have Jeremy back in the squad," Van Bommel told a press conference.

"It certainly makes selecting the starting line-up more difficult, but I think all five wingers are capable of playing on either side. It's a puzzle, but a nice problem to have. I can't give you an answer yet as to who will play," he said.
Belgium, however, will be without record goalscorer Romelu Lukaku.
"Romelu is having some problems with his hip. He was already feeling it yesterday. He is still able to train, but we have mutually decided not to include him in the line-up," added the coach.
"He is an important player for us, both on and off the pitch. He's only started one match so far, but he has already made an important contribution, including as a substitute.
"So I hope I can get him fit again in time for the match against Italy," Van Bommel said.
Belgium are third in Group A1 with six points, behind leaders France on 10 and Italy on seven. The top two advance to the quarter-finals in March.
France face Italy in Milan on Thursday.

(Writing by Mark Gleeson in Cape Town; Editing by Toby Davis)

Nov 11 : Australia centre Len Ikitau said the Wallabies must change their mindset for Sunday's test against Scotland at Murrayfield or risk another damaging defeat after last weekend’s record loss to England.
The 2027 World Cup hosts went down 45-22 at Twickenham on Sunday, the most points Australia have conceded in a test against England. They face a Scotland side also seeking a response after losing heavily to New Zealand.
"England kind of gave it to us from the start and put us on a load of pressure and played the way that they wanted to play and we kind of sat back and watched them," Ikitau said.
"We can't be doing that against Scotland; we really want to be going out there, especially in defence, and put them under the pressure.

"Playing in Scotland, that's where they come alive. We’ve worked on that massively this week," he told a press conference on Wednesday.
Ikitau said he had no idea why Australia were so flat at Twickenham. 
"We had a great week ahead of the game, I thought the preparations were on point but sometimes you get to a game and you're just not there and I felt like we were off as a team and as a collective."
One problem is finding a settled partnership in midfield.
"We’re all over the shop at the moment and there have been some major fixes for us as a backline, working at training," Ikitau said.
"It’s been pretty tough trying to stick with the same centre pairing, and being able to play consistently with the same people, but I feel like we've got a lot of good centres."

(Writing by Mark Gleeson in Cape Town; Editing by Ed Osmond)

items.body:
＜外為市場＞　

ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。

ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１ドル＝１５９．８３円となり、２カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。心理的な節目である１６０円に迫った。

ユーロは０．６１％安の１．１１ドルに下落し、前営業日からの下げを拡大して２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。

ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。

ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。

英ポンドは０．４７％安の１．３３ドルとなり、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。一方、ドルは対スイスフランで０．８６％高の０．８３２フランとなり、１０月半ば以来の高値を付けた。

ドル指数は０．６３％高の１０２．８５。一時、２０２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．１６％高の７万３８９０．４８ドル。イーサは０．８５％高の２０７２．４０ドルとなった。

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

ＦＴＳＥ１００種指数が上昇して取引を終えた。原油と銅の価格上昇を受け、エネルギー株と鉱業株が買われた。

中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．７２％上昇した。

エネルギー株指数は１．７％上昇し、８営業日ぶりに反発した。原油価格が前日に付けた２カ月ぶりの安値から持ち直した。

石油大手ＢＰは２．７％高、シェルは１．３％高だった。

産業用金属・鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇に連れ、１．８％近く上昇した。

アングロ・アメリカン、アントファガスタ、グレンコアはいずれも２．２─２．３％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

終値で過去最高値を更新し、取引時間中の最高値にも迫った。シーメンス・エナジーと米コアウィーブの明るい業績見通しが人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への信頼感を高め、テクノロジー株を押し上げた。

欧州株価指数ＳＴＯＸＸ６００種は０．７２％高の６６３．０５で取引を終え、取引時間中の最高値６６３．４１まであとわずかに迫った。

ドイツのＤＡＸ指数は１．２％上昇し、欧州の主要市場を上回る値上がりとなった。

ＡＩ関連機器を手がけるシーメンス・エナジーが１０．８％急伸した。２０２７年の利益率見通しを引き上げ、配当を３倍超に増やす計画を発表した。

同業のシュナイダーエレクトリックとルグランはそれぞれ３％、２．２％上昇。テクノロジー株指数は２．５％上昇した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りがおおむね横ばいとなった。前日に発表された強い米消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）を受けて米国債市場が動揺し、欧州にも影響が波及したが、この日は落ち着きを取り戻した。

米債券市場はベテランズデーの祝日で休場となり、市場の流動性が低下。世界的に取引が低調となった。

ドイツ１０年債利回りは直近で１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．３２％。

米経済の重要性を踏まえ、この統計を受けて欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）が１２月に利上げするとの見方もやや強まり、現在はほぼ確実視されている。

金融政策に敏感なドイツ２年債利回りは２ｂｐ上昇し、３．１０％となった。１０日には８ｂｐ上昇していた。

足元の原油価格の動きは、利回りの低下を支持している。北海ブレント先物は８月下旬以来の安値付近まで下落した。これが、売り圧力にさらされてきたフランス国債に一定の安心感をもたらした。

フランス１０年債利回りは１ｂｐ上昇の４．８０％。１０日には７ｂｐ上昇していた。

独仏１０年債利回り格差は１４７ｂｐで横ばいだった。１０月には１７８ｂｐと、２０１１年以来の水準に拡大していた。

スペイン１０年債利回りも１ｂｐ上昇した。スペインでは住宅問題への怒りを背景に労働者が１４年ぶりのゼネストに踏み切ったが、市場は材料視しなかった。

items.body:
欧州市場サマリー（11日）
3:21 配信

＜外為市場＞　

ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。

ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１ドル＝１５９．８３円となり、２カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。心理的な節目である１６０円に迫った。

ユーロは０．６１％安の１．１１ドルに下落し、前営業日からの下げを拡大して２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。

ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。

ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。

英ポンドは０．４７％安の１．３３ドルとなり、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。一方、ドルは対スイスフランで０．８６％高の０．８３２フランとなり、１０月半ば以来の高値を付けた。

ドル指数は０．６３％高の１０２．８５。一時、２０２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．１６％高の７万３８９０．４８ドル。イーサは０．８５％高の２０７２．４０ドルとなった。

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

ＦＴＳＥ１００種指数が上昇して取引を終えた。原油と銅の価格上昇を受け、エネルギー株と鉱業株が買われた。

中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．７２％上昇した。

エネルギー株指数は１．７％上昇し、８営業日ぶりに反発した。原油価格が前日に付けた２カ月ぶりの安値から持ち直した。

石油大手ＢＰは２．７％高、シェルは１．３％高だった。

産業用金属・鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇に連れ、１．８％近く上昇した。

アングロ・アメリカン、アントファガスタ、グレンコアはいずれも２．２─２．３％上昇した。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

終値で過去最高値を更新し、取引時間中の最高値にも迫った。シーメンス・エナジーと米コアウィーブの明るい業績見通しが人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への信頼感を高め、テクノロジー株を押し上げた。

欧州株価指数ＳＴＯＸＸ６００種は０．７２％高の６６３．０５で取引を終え、取引時間中の最高値６６３．４１まであとわずかに迫った。

ドイツのＤＡＸ指数は１．２％上昇し、欧州の主要市場を上回る値上がりとなった。

ＡＩ関連機器を手がけるシーメンス・エナジーが１０．８％急伸した。２０２７年の利益率見通しを引き上げ、配当を３倍超に増やす計画を発表した。

同業のシュナイダーエレクトリックとルグランはそれぞれ３％、２．２％上昇。テクノロジー株指数は２．５％上昇した。

items.title: CoreWeave sparks AI cloud stock rally, lifts Nvidia as results ease bubble fears
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: CoreWeave jumped more than 20 per cent on Wednesday, igniting a rally in battered AI cloud stocks, as its hefty spending yielded strong revenue growth and the company signaled a pullback from the ...
items.body: CoreWeave jumped more than 20 per cent on Wednesday, igniting a rally in battered AI cloud stocks, as its hefty spending yielded strong revenue growth and the company signaled a pullback from the borrowing binge that had set off alarms of an AI bubble. The earnings also helped lift shares of key CoreWeave backer Nvidia by two per cent, after a bruising two-day slide driven by worries about CEO Jensen Huang’s future at the company following his affair with a Chinese businesswoman alleged to be a spy for Beijing. Shares of so-called “neoclouds” including Nebius and Iren rallied after facing weeks of turmoil on fears that their debt-fuelled data centre expansion could backfire if AI demand slows. “CoreWeave’s earnings directly addressed the fear that’s driven this whole selloff,” said Dan Sheehan, director of portfolio management at Telos Wealth Advisors. “The neocloud that became the poster child for AI financing worries took real weight off the fear that had been the heart of the selloff.” The Democratic midterm sweep last week had dealt a blow to the industry, with several winning candidates campaigning for tighter regulation and moratoriums on new data center construction, including in the crucial market of Texas. CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator told Reuters on Tuesday that greater scrutiny could slow data center construction across the industry, but he did not expect it to significantly alter the company’s expansion plans or drive up costs. There will be no impact to CoreWeave’s planned capacity additions over the next year, he added. The company also said it would not tap unsecured debt markets after a recent spike in borrowing costs, and that cash flow from existing contracts would cover both current and future debt repayments, a financing plan that analysts said was credible. “CoreWeave delivered about the best quarter we could have asked for. Stats were good-to-great, funding concerns were addressed and the strategic moves make sense,” Bernstein analysts led by Madison Rezaei said in a client note. But they warned that CoreWeave “will be among the first and hardest hit” when the crunch in AI computing capacity eases. The risks of mistiming AI investments became evident on Tuesday as SoftBank took a US$3.7 billion writedown on non-refundable payments for equipment to power its U.S. data centres, driving a second-quarter net loss of $7 billion, its first in nearly two years. Nvidia boss Huang’s troubles have left the AI industry reeling too, with the controversy escalating on Tuesday as allegations emerged that his relationship aided multi-billion-dollar Nvidia chip shipments to China. Republican U.S. Senator Kevin Cramer from the Senate Banking Committee called on Huang to step down as CEO. For now, CoreWeave’s results have given investors in AI infrastructure stocks reason to cheer, with Nebius, Iren, Oracle and Applied Digital climbing between six per cent and 14 per cent. All the stocks but Nebius have lost 32 per cent to 48 per cent this year as of Tuesday, while Nebius has surged 60 per cent. Together, the companies, including CoreWeave, were set to gain some $36 billion in market value, while Nvidia alone stood to add nearly $100 billion, if current gains hold. Nebius is due to report results before Thursday’s opening bell. (Reporting by Aditya Soni in Bengaluru; Editing by Devika Syamnath)

items.title: Odd Lots: The AI Trade Shrugs Off a Blue Wave and a Tech Scandal
items.summary:
It’s been a big month so far for American politics and the tech industry. Democrats deliver a sweeping win across the country, calling continued AI development into question. Nvidia launches an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy. There are plenty of things to make investors jittery, yet we’re seeing a tech rally as markets await the upcoming Anthropic IPO.

Bloomberg’s Michael Ball joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway on the Odd Lots podcast to unpack why the tech trade is showing resilience despite macro jitters. (Source: Bloomberg)

LONDON, Nov 11 : Harry Kane has spent much of the last decade rewriting the record books and on Thursday the striker will add another chapter when he becomes England's most-capped men's player with his 126th appearance against Croatia.
Before kickoff at Wembley, the 33-year-old Bayern Munich forward will present the Ballon d'Or trophy he won last month to England's fans before moving past former goalkeeper Peter Shilton's long-standing record.
"Definitely up there with the biggest (achievements of my career)," England captain Kane told reporters at former club Tottenham Hotspur's training ground on Wednesday after being given a standing ovation when he entered the room.

"It showcases consistency at the highest level and to reach the number of caps I have is a testament to the things I spoke about in my (Ballon d'Or) speech behind the scenes, the dedication and for sure it is one of the biggest milestones of my career."
Kane is never one to shout his name from the rooftops, but having moved past Wayne Rooney's England scoring record of 53 goals in 2023 he has surged to 91 and ranks among his country's all-time greats, even if ending England's long wait for a major trophy has remained elusive.
England manager Thomas Tuchel said Kane was the "perfect captain and a leader by example" and described his playing style as unique, adding that he is getting smarter with age.
Asked if Kane is England's greatest player, Tuchel said: "I don't know but he is up there of course. It's now proven and it's always nice if things are proven.
"He has his collection of prizes, he will score more goals, he will get more games and tomorrow he will start as captain of course. It's a big occasion to present the Ballon d'Or to our fans and bring it to the country and when he gets his all-time record for 126 matches.
"It's a beautiful, beautiful occasion."
PRESENTATION AT WEMBLEY
Kane will be honoured in a pre-match presentation at Wembley before the UEFA Nations League match against Croatia with Shilton, who has held the England appearance record since 1989, also involved.
Only a handful of active men's internationals have made more appearances for their countries than Kane, whose England debut came as a substitute against Lithuania in 2015 when he scored little more than a minute after coming on.
Once the anthems have been sung and the record secured, Kane's attention will turn to the next target in a career that continues to gather milestones.
"We spoke in the last camp about the 100 goals for England, I think that's another incredible milestone to try and reach as soon as possible," said Kane, who scored a remarkable 73 goals in 65 games for Bayern Munich and England last season.
"Right now, I'm feeling really, really good so hopefully many more years to see what else I can achieve.

Spain also prepared for heavy rain and flooding, with over 3,000 people evacuated due to the risk of a dam overflowing.

A person sits at the Graca viewpoint overlooking downtown Lisbon under rain clouds, Tuesday, Nov 10, 2026, as Portugal gets ready for the arrival of Storm Charles expected to bring heavy rain and wind gusts. (Photo: AP/Armando Franca)

LISBON: Airlines cancelled more than 200 flights in and out of Portugal , while schools and hundreds of supermarkets and businesses closed on Wednesday (Nov 11) as Storm Charles made landfall, bringing heavy downpours and gale-force winds.
Although the storm was less severe than initially expected, the government, criticised for its slow response to a succession of storm s in January and February, had taken pre-emptive steps, putting all emergency services and army units on alert, cancelling classes, shutting non-essential public services and advising people to stay indoors.
Portugal 's weather service IPMA said the eye of the storm had split in two over the Atlantic, diminishing its strength when it arrived via the southern Algarve region. It was expected to reach most of southern Portugal and the Lisbon region through late afternoon.
Civil Protection Commander Mario Silvestre said authorities were maintaining high alert levels for flash floods, wind and rough seas after registering 538 incidents since midnight.

Storm Charles had already swept through the Madeira archipelago, causing some flooding and felling trees. Emergency services rescued a man swept away when water flooded his garage on the island of Madeira, but no casualties were reported.
Since Sunday, Portugal and neighbouring Spain have been pummelled by heavy rains brought by Storm Bruna, with flooding reported in several areas including road tunnels in Lisbon, which were mostly shut on Wednesday.
The new storm was expected to reach southwestern Spain on Wednesday afternoon, with the country's weather service AEMET warning of "serious or very serious" impact from heavy rain, strong winds and rough seas that could exacerbate conditions caused by Storm Bruna.
In central Spain, authorities maintained the evacuation of more than 3,000 people in Piedralaves, whom they removed from their homes on Tuesday due to the risk of a local dam overflowing, and warned that rainfall was expected to intensify from midday.

Nov 11 : Anthropic could see record buying by retail investors in its market debut, potentially surpassing SpaceX and making it one of the biggest single-day retail purchases in history, Vanda Research said in a note on Wednesday.
The research firm expects Anthropic's debut to attract about $250 million in net retail buying, based on its analysis of retail activity on listing days and the volume of its pre-IPO perpetual futures traded on Hyperliquid. This would be twice SpaceX's IPO record of $118 million in retail buying.
"Judging by pre-IPO perp trading, Anthropic is shaping up to be a record retail IPO," Viraj Patel, global macro strategist at Vanda Research said, in the note.

Pre-IPO perpetual futures are a type of derivative contract which trade on exchanges like Hyperliquid and Coinbase, and allow traders to bet on private companies' valuation. They have no direct link to the underlying shares but are priced with reference to the company's latest disclosed pre-IPO valuation.
Only six stocks have topped $250 million in single-day retail buying since 2024, the data firm added.
"Anthropic next week could draw the kind of retail buying that we've rarely seen in our data," Vanda said.
Anthropic is targeting a valuation of up to $1.4 trillion in its IPO, with shares expected to start trading on the Nasdaq on November 19.

items.title: CoreWeave shares surge over 26%, spark rally in battered AI cloud stocks
items.author: ETMarkets.com
items.summary: CoreWeave's shares experienced a significant increase of over 26% due to strong revenue growth. The company's recent earnings alleviated concerns about a potential artificial intelligence bubble and heavy borrowing. Following these results, shares of Nvidia and other neocloud companies also rose notably. Investors are reassured as CoreWeave plans to avoid unsecured debt markets in the near future. This market movement highlights optimism regarding the future of AI infrastructure investments.
items.body: CoreWeave shares surged more than 26% on Wednesday, fuelling a rally in battered AI cloud stocks after heavy infrastructure spending delivered strong revenue growth and the company signalled a retreat from the borrowing spree that had raised fears of an artificial intelligence bubble, Reuters reported.CoreWeave shares were trading at $61.61, up $12.88 or 26.43% over the previous close.The results also helped lift Nvidia, a major CoreWeave backer, by 2%. Nvidia had fallen sharply over the previous two sessions amid uncertainty surrounding CEO Jensen Huang following reports about his relationship with a Chinese businesswoman alleged to have ties to Beijing’s intelligence apparatus.Shares of other so-called neocloud companies, including Nebius and Iren, also rallied after weeks of pressure. Investors have worried that their debt-funded data-centre expansion could backfire if demand for AI computing weakens.For live updates on US Markets, click here“CoreWeave’s earnings directly addressed the fear that’s driven this whole selloff,” said Dan Sheehan, director of portfolio management at Telos Wealth Advisors, according to Reuters. “The neocloud that became the poster child for AI financing worries took real weight off the fear that had been the heart of the selloff.”Democrats’ sweep of last week’s US midterm elections had further unsettled the industry. Several victorious candidates campaigned for stricter regulation and moratoriums on new data-centre construction, including in Texas, a key market for the sector.CoreWeave CEO Michael Intrator told Reuters on Tuesday that increased regulatory scrutiny could slow data-centre development across the industry. However, he did not expect it to significantly affect the company’s expansion plans or raise costs.Intrator said CoreWeave’s planned capacity additions over the next year would remain unaffected.Also Read: Is AI wheel broken? Julius Baer flags 3 variables shaping AI investments ahead of Anthropic IPOThe company also said it would avoid unsecured debt markets following a recent surge in borrowing costs. Cash flow from existing contracts would cover repayments on both current and future debt, it added—a financing plan analysts described as credible.“CoreWeave delivered about the best quarter we could have asked for. Stats were good-to-great, funding concerns were addressed and the strategic moves make sense,” Bernstein analysts led by Madison Rezaei said in a client note.However, they warned that CoreWeave “will be among the first and hardest hit” once the shortage of AI computing capacity eases.The risks of mistiming AI investments were evident on Tuesday when SoftBank recorded a $3.7 billion write-down on non-refundable payments for equipment intended to power its US data centres. The charge contributed to a second-quarter net loss of $7 billion, the company’s first in nearly two years.Uncertainty surrounding Huang has also weighed on the AI sector. The controversy intensified on Tuesday after reports alleged that his relationship helped facilitate billions of dollars in Nvidia chip shipments to China.Republican US Senator Kevin Cramer, a member of the Senate Banking Committee, called on Huang to step down as Nvidia CEO.For now, CoreWeave’s results have given AI infrastructure investors some relief. Nebius, Iren, Oracle and Applied Digital climbed between 6% and 14%.With the exception of Nebius, the stocks had fallen between 32% and 48% this year through Tuesday. Nebius, by contrast, had gained 60%.Together, the companies—including CoreWeave—were on track to add about $36 billion in market value if the gains held. Nvidia alone was positioned to gain nearly $100 billion.Nebius is scheduled to report its results before Thursday’s opening bell.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

items.title: 欧州外為市場＝ドル上昇、米12月利上げ織り込む　ユーロ1年半ぶり安値
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［ニューヨーク　１１日　ロイター］ - 欧州外為市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇した。米国の強いインフレ指標や当局者のタカ派的な発言を受けて、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げに踏み切るとの観測が強まったことが背景。

ドルは対円で０．６９％高の１ドル＝１５９．８３円となり、２カ月超ぶりの高値を付けた。心理的な節目である１６０円に迫った。

ユーロは０．６１％安の１．１１ドルに下落し、前営業日からの下げを拡大して２０２５年５月以来の安値を付けた。

ブラウン・ブラザーズ・ハリマンのグローバル市場戦略責任者、エリアス・ハダッド氏は「１０月米ＣＰＩの上振れを背景としたＦＲＢ金利見通しのタカ派的なシフトに支えられ、幅広くドル高が進んでいる。最近のＦＲＢ当局者の発言もそれを増幅させた」と述べた。

ウォラー理事や米ダラス地区連銀のローガン総裁らＦＲＢ当局者の最近の発言は、高インフレへの懸念と０．５％ポイント（５０ｂｐ）の大幅利上げの可能性を示唆するもので、利上げ観測を後押しした。

英ポンドは０．４７％安の１．３３ドルとなり、２週間ぶりの安値付近で推移した。一方、ドルは対スイスフランで０．８６％高の０．８３２フランとなり、１０月半ば以来の高値を付けた。

ドル指数は０．６３％高の１０２．８５。一時、２０２５年４月以来の高値を付けた。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは０．１６％高の７万３８９０．４８ドル。イーサは０．８５％高の２０７２．４０ドルとなった。

items.title: Benchmarks rise nearly 1%; auto, bank stocks lead gains amid FPI inflows
items.author: Shilpa Rangarajan
items.summary: Benchmark equity indices extended their gains on Wednesday, with the Sensex, boosted by auto and banking stocks, rising 0.95 per cent. While the Sensex closed at 81,879.40, the NSE Nifty 50 gained ...
items.body: Benchmark equity indices extended their gains on Wednesday, with the Sensex, boosted by auto and banking stocks, rising 0.95 per cent. While the Sensex closed at 81,879.40, the NSE Nifty 50 gained 0.84 per cent and ended at 25,255.05, rising 9.55 per cent this month. Foreign portfolio investor (FPI) inflows and profit booking steered the market towards a second consecutive gaining session on Wednesday. It was also aided by crude prices falling below the $95/barrel mark in November. The markets are moving up because Brent is falling. Brent is down 19 per cent this month from $113.43 on October 30 to $92 on Wednesday.  The BSE 250 SmallCap index rose 1.15 per cent and the BSE 150 MidCap index was up 1.06 per cent. The NSE's Nifty Smallcap 100 and Nifty Microcap 250 gained 1.59 per cent and 1.87 per cent, respectively.  Mahindra & Mahindra (M&M) was the top Nifty gainer, rising 5.3 per cent to ₹3,465. InterGlobe Aviation (IndiGo) gained 4.33 per cent to ₹5,665. Adani Ports was the biggest laggard, falling 1.84 per cent to ₹1,907. Since October 30, oil marketing companies (OMCs) rallied the most. Hindustan Petroleum is up 17.5 per cent, Indian Oil 14.0 per cent and Bharat Petroleum 10.7 per cent because cheaper crude widens their margins while pump prices stay frozen. InterGlobe Aviation, whose biggest cost is jet fuel, gained 16.1 per cent, and Asian Paints, which uses crude derivatives as raw material, surged 9.9 per cent. Oil India, a producer that earns less when prices fall, is down 1.8 per cent. Taken together, oil, gas and coal companies have added ₹3.3 trillion in market value this month, up 11.9 per cent sequentially. “Some profit booking emerged at higher levels, trimming the initial gains. Despite this, the overall market undertone remained positive, supported by strong foreign institutional investor (FII) buying, declining crude oil prices, a recovery in the rupee and improving corporate earnings,” said Pabitro Mukherjee, deputy vice-president — research at Bajaj Broking. FPIs bought a net ₹12,563 crore of equities on Wednesday, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) sold a net ₹8,434 crore. In November so far, FPIs bought ₹65,735 crore and DIIs sold ₹40,503 crore. Three of the 10 biggest FPI buying days on record was in this month (November 5, November 6 and November 11), according to Bloomberg and exchange data. FPIs bought a net ₹53,739 crore of Indian equities between November 2 and November 9, after pulling out ₹34,843 crore in October. Brent crude has fallen about 19 per cent this month to around $91.5 a barrel on Tuesday from ₹113.43 on October 30, even as Brent Futures rose 1.88 per cent intraday on Wednesday to $93.21 per barrel. Again, earnings are on track. Broking reports are putting the earnings growth numbers for the Nifty 50 companies at 20 per cent. Apurva Sheth, head of research, Samco Securities, said the markets started on a high note but moderated at close on profit booking. “There will be some sector rotation which is happening already in microcaps, smallcaps and midcaps. So, largecaps will cool off for a while. IT stocks, which were the best performers last month, will also continue to see some correction and healthy profit booking and then start moving up,” he said. On the Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), December silver futures rose 2.19 per cent to ₹1,86,574 a kg, while gold futures gained 0.47 per cent to ₹1,41,185 per 10 grams. The BSE IPO index gained 1.64 per cent. Among BSE sectoral indices, the PSU Bank jumped 3.03 per cent, Telecommunication 2.41 per cent, auto 2.05 per cent and Bankex 1.94 per cent on Wednesday. Information technology declined 0.35 per cent and Realty 0.58 per cent. On the NSE on Wednesday, the Nifty PSU Bank rose 2.94 per cent, the Nifty Auto 2.14 per cent and the Nifty Chemicals 2.10 per cent. The Nifty Capital Markets gained 1.99 per cent and the Nifty Private Bank rose 1.14 per cent, with both touching record highs during the session.

Millions of Spaniards stage first general strike in 14 years as anger rages over housing

Protesters carry a banner reading “Speculation No. Guarantee The Right To Housing”, during a strike over soaring housing costs and stagnant wages, in Bilbao, Spain, Nov 11, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Vincent West)

MADRID: Four million Spanish workers t ook part in a general strike on Wednesday (Nov 11), unions said, enduring stormy weather to set up picket lines in a protest against the country's housing affordability crisis less than three weeks before a snap general election.
It is the first general strike since workers downed tools in 2012 against austerity measures during the euro zone debt crisis. The walkout is backed by Spain's two largest unions, UGT and CCOO, representing more than a million workers, as well as tenants' associations angry about rising rents and evictions.
Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez hopes to harness voter resentment over housing in the Nov 29 election to shift the political narrative away from corruption cases involving his inner circle and a deadly train crash last month. So far, his Socialist Party still trails in opinion polls.
Unions described the strike as a success even though participation was uneven across Spain, with the strongest support in coastal regions where housing pressures have been particularly acute.

SHOPS SHUTTERED On Madrid's Gran Via, one of the capital's main shopping streets, protesters cheered as stores including Primark, H&M and Pull & Bear drew their shutters amid a heavy riot police presence.
"We're going to close the Mango store," the protesters chanted as they jangled sets of house keys above their heads.
Many shops in Barcelona were also closed and boarded up in anticipation of unrest.
Spain has a deficit of about 750,000 homes, which is set to grow to more than a million by 2028, according to the central bank.
With fewer people able to afford a home, renting has increased sharply, putting pressure on that market. The average rental price of €1,176 (US$1,315) is equivalent to about 98.7 per cent of a young person's average monthly salary in Spain, according to the Youth Council of Spain.
"I’m 36 years old and I still can’t move out on my own," said Madrid resident Jesus Gonzalez , who works in a hospital IT department and supports the strike . "Rents just keep going up, house prices just keep going up, and it’s simply impossible."

Smoke rises after fireworks exploded next to demonstrators, during a 24-hour nationwide general strike in Barcelona, Spain, Nov 11, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Albert Gea)

TURNOUT STRONGEST AT PORTS, AUTO PLANTS Angela de Miguel, vice president of Spain's main business lobby CEOE, said the strike was counterproductive because small businesses were also affected by the housing crisis, since shortages of homes made recruitment more challenging.
Speaking on state broadcaster TVE, she said the solution was to build more homes and to lower taxes in construction and the home-buying process.
Plans for massive protest marches in the afternoon were threatened by two heavy storms, dubbed Charles and Bruna , with unions suspending a demonstration in the southern port city of Cadiz.
T he tenants' union said it still expected participation in the strike to reach 5 million people by the end of the day. Spain has around 23 million workers, according to the national statistics institute.
According to UGT and CCOO, participation in the strike reached 90 per cent at ports and in the automotive sector, with "total stoppages" reported at factories including Volkswagen's in Navarre and SEAT's in Barcelona.
Electricity demand dropped by as much as 15.5 per cent between 10am and 11am, according to Spain's grid operator Red Electrica.

Related:

CNA Explains: Why are violent Gen Z protests breaking out across Europe?

Thousands march in Madrid to protest Spain's housing crisis after eviction of 87-year-old woman

LESS IMPACT DUE TO REMOTE WORKING Barcelona's metro said no trains would run outside peak commuting hours, while Madrid's metro said peak-hour usage was down 42 per cent compared to the same period last week.
However, w ith more people able to work remotely and the increasing weight of services in Spain’s economy, the impact of the strike is likely to be less pronounced than in previous years , according to Miguel Cardoso, chief economist at BBVA Research. He estimated that the strike could shave 0.1 per cent-0.2 per cent off Spain’s annual gross domestic product.
Spain's fast-growing hospitality and finance industries are less unionised than the public and industrial sectors.
P olice had reported 40 arrests by midday from 476 incidents linked to the general strike , including blockades of offices and industrial estates and burning of rubbish containers.
Unions said they would file a criminal complaint against what they described as a “disproportionate” response during a police operation involving tear gas and batons that left 20 protesters injured.
The strike follows weeks of demonstrations provoked by the eviction and subsequent death of an 87-year-old woman in Madrid.
Those protests, along with parliament's rejection last month of g over nment decrees aimed at curbing evictions and limiting rent pressures, prompted Sanchez to call the snap election.

米財務長官、商務長官を追及　エヌビディアＣＥＯ不倫相手の企業巡り＝報道
1:26 配信

2026年10月29日、ベセント米財務長官。REUTERS/Eric Lee（ロイター） ［１１日　ロイター］　 - ベセント米財務長官が、シンガポールを拠点とするクラウドコンピューティング企業メガスピードを国家安全保障上の懸念がある企業のリストに掲載しなかったとして、ラトニック米商務長官を問いただしたことが分かった。アクシオスが１１日、事情に詳しい複数の関係者の話として報じた。

メガスピードは、米半導体大手エヌビディアの顧客であり、同社のジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の不倫相手とされる中国人女性アリス・フアン氏が支配株主となっていたことがある。アリス・フアン氏は中国の情報機関の協力者だったと報じられており、メガスピードは米国の輸出規制対象となっているエヌビディアの先端半導体を中国企業が入手するのを手助けした疑いが持たれている。
